conditions.distribution: Major Update 4 development inventory on feature/major-update-4

conditions.runtime: dedicated server with matching Unified Xaero Worldmap, Xaero World Map and JEM Server artifacts

change.summary: Require the complete Xaero terrain-sharing chain on every Major Update 4 client while preserving native map and waypoint ownership

modifiers.before: The artifacts and JEM full-cave adapters existed, but their all-client Major Update 4 delivery contract was implicit

after.scope: explored terrain in every accepted dimension and cave layer, including JEM full-cave acceptance

modifiers.before: Native personal map data remains outside the shared-terrain adapter
modifiers.after: Waypoints, homes, death points, labels, colors, groups and settings remain private to their creator

cause.owner: Unified Xaero Worldmap and JEMServer xaero.shared adapter

rationale.purpose: Make cave-map sharing available to every player who installs Major Update 4 without exposing personal waypoint data
rationale.user_requested: Make the Xaero cave mod available to all in the same Major Update
rationale.implementation_choices: Keep the already installed native addon and matching JEM full-cave extension, then make their mandatory AutoModpack delivery boundary explicit instead of adding a competing map owner

introduced.summary: Record and verify the all-client Xaero cave-sharing artifact chain

history.summary: Verified canonical, server and active AutoModpack artifacts and preserved native waypoint privacy

relations: Xaero explored terrain -> Unified Xaero Worldmap -> JEM full-cave acceptance -> matching Major Update 4 clients
notes: The active test jem generation contains byte-identical copies of the canonical Xaero and JEM Server artifacts
No native Xaero GUI, camera, controls, renderer, map store or personal waypoint behavior is replaced
MineRENT, stable JustEnoughMods and the immutable release baseline are unchanged
unresolved: Player-rendered cave synchronization acceptance remains pending because no client or gameplay launch was authorized
